administration.note: Reform UK won the 1 May 2025 all-out election (44 of 70; 42 by June 2026 after two defections incl Cllr Cain Parkinson to Conservative) and runs the Executive with a clear majority. Leader Cllr Sean Matthews survived an internal challenge from Cllr Liam Kelly at the May 2026 AGM, removed Kelly from the Executive and absorbed the Growth portfolio himself. Composition: Reform 42, Conservative 15, Liberal Democrat 5, Independent Group 4, Labour 2, Independent 2. Leader of the Opposition: Cllr Richard Davies (Conservative, 15).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no Exceptional Financial Support, no Best Value Notice). DSG into structural deficit for the first time in 2025/26; DfE 90% write-off; override ends end of 2027/28.
mtfs._source: Lincolnshire CC 2026/27 budget (lincolnshire.moderngov.co.uk docs s72426 + s71846), full Council 20 Feb 2026, pulled and read directly.
